verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing product catalog API, so agent checkout is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers only product search, lookup, affiliate buy URLs and sale attribution; its UCP support is explicitly limited to search and lookup. MPP is documented only as a way for agents to pay for Channel3 API usage, not as a delegated payment credential for merchant checkout. There is no evidence of checkout sessions, delegated payment credentials or order confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can complete a purchase end-to-end — checkout session, delegated payment credential, confirmed order
